name: x402 Sentinel
description: A monitoring router that sits between AI agents and x402 HTTP 402 payment endpoints. It watches every payment requirement and batches small payments to cut per-call overhead. It also tracks facilitators and settlement outcomes so operators can see where money goes.

name: Ribozome
description: A DeFi yield vault product that pools deposits and routes them into yield strategies. Vault shares follow the ERC-4626 tokenized vault standard. Safe operation depends on reliable oracle pricing and tight control of slippage.

name: Second Brain
description: A knowledge-graph app that reads what a user saves and keeps only what is new to that user. It splits articles into claims and embeds each claim for vector search with an HNSW index. A graph database links claims, concepts, and projects.
